# NATIONAL HANDOVER PACK — generated 2026-08-16

**GENERATED by `scripts/build_handover_pack.py`.** Regenerate; never hand-edit.

This Indiana app is the baseline for a national tool. **What transfers is not the data —
it is the contracts, the honesty grammar, and the errors.** A national build will make every
mistake below at fifty times the scale, so the errors are listed first.

---

## 1. The errors that cost the most, and what each one teaches

| the reading | the truth | the transferable rule |
|---|---|---|
| `has_si_signal` = 847,410 parcels | 99.2% was empty land; the only parcel-keyed input was footprint ABSENCE | a signal that fires on almost everything is measuring the wrong thing |
| 0 of 945,896 signal rows joined to parcels | three key NAMESPACES (`IN:` prefix, 7-digit local id, punctuated state id) | when a join reads zero, suspect the key format before the data |
| "Marion has no crosswalk" | true of the tables we HELD; the county publishes one (`sde_Parcel/5`, 347,049 rows) | a dead end in your warehouse is not a dead end in the publisher's catalogue |
| 14,293 parcels admitted | 95% of South Bend "code enforcement" is litter and weeds; 90% of Evansville "demolition" is residential teardowns | read the VALUE VOCABULARY before trusting a count |
| 92 data-centre pins | census CITY CENTROIDS rendered as facility locations | a centroid answers "which town", never "how far" |
| 100% spatial match on first run | one inverted whole-Earth parcel swallowed every point | a perfect join is a defect until proven otherwise |
| "0 high-priority violators" | 95 exist; `distress_class` is a priority ladder that counts each facility once | never read a category off a mutually-exclusive ladder |
| 95 rates below the wholesale floor | most were 0.0, an ABSENT rate treated as zero | unpublished is NULL, never 0 — and check your own code against that rule |
| a 12-month LMP average | the feed had a gap; it was 39 days of summer | assert the window you got, not the one you asked for |
| "9 ECHO columns missing" | all present under SCREAMING_SNAKE vs camelCase | exact-name matching across naming conventions produces false gaps |
| WARN deduped to 1,252 | a symmetric 74/74 split was city WHITESPACE, not divergence | suspiciously symmetric residuals are usually formatting |
| 199 of 199 objects wired | the denominator moves on every build that registers something | make the census a script, never a number in a document |

## 2. The rulings that shaped the product

1. **Seller intent is admitted at the NON-RESIDENTIAL level only.** A ~300 MW datacentre and
   a ~5 MW BESS both need land a house does not have.
2. **Severity gates every signal.** Only distress that would plausibly move an owner to sell.
3. **Capability is a separate question from signal.** 69% of flagged parcels cannot host even
   5 MW — an expected and useful filter, not a defect. Measure it beside the flag.
4. **Where two measures disagree, take the SMALLER** and label it disputed. The larger number
   is the one that makes a site look viable.
5. **Vacancy is two things.** Footprint absence is a land state, not intent.
6. **Union-and-dedupe every duplicated subject**; never two partial layers of one thing.
7. **Cannot-assess renders as itself** and is dropped from the denominator, never scored 0.

## 3. The payload contract

```
BigQuery (indiana_app) --> gzipped GeoJSON/JSON --> committed --> browser DecompressionStream
```

- one county file per FIPS; the class union is exported from ONE snapshot so two counties are
  never two generations (the partial-swap hazard)
- an export ABORTS rather than half-writes if its source columns are absent
- detail fields are emitted only where they mean something; an absent key reads as "no
  admitted signal", which is the truth, not as "cannot assess"
- every figure carries its source table and build date, read from `_registry` at render time

## 5. What a national build must acquire that Indiana did not have

- **Owner names on parcels.** `mat_parcel_attrs.parcel_owner` is NULL on all 3,553,381 Indiana
  rows. That single gap blocks FIVE signals (D9, D18, D11, D27, and IDEM enforcement).
- **Component-level tariffs.** Indiana has 3 component rows and 2 are `not_held`. No
  component-level Indiana tariff exists in the estate, so no rate can be quoted — only
  compared against four proxies with a wholesale floor.
- **Local ordinance text at scale.** Codified search finds almost nothing: the
  decision-relevant regulation is county MORATORIA on county websites, and one county
  approved a 7.1M sq ft datacentre by administrative interpretation under a code that never
  mentions data centres. **Codified silence is not permissiveness.**
